title: Oozing Italian Chickpeas Casserole
description: A cozy, herbal Puglian-inspired casserole that oozes with pickle juice and parmesan, perfect for a high-protein dinner in individual mini-cocottes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C and lightly grease four mini-cocotte dishes with olive oil.
In a skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and red pepper flakes, cooking for 1 minute to caramelize the paste.
Add the cooked chickpeas and pickle juice to the skillet, mixing well to coat.
Transfer the chickpea mixture into the greased cocottes, spreading evenly.
Sprinkle chopped oregano, basil, and grated parmesan over the top of each dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the top is golden and the mixture oozes slightly.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
